scripts.pub:check: npm whoami && npm ping && npm publish --dry-run
scripts.pub: npm run build && npm run pub:check && npm publish --access public --auth-type=legacy
scripts.pub:otp: npm run build && npm run pub:check && npm publish --access public --auth-type=legacy --otp=$NPM_OTP
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version=false && npm run pub
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version=false && npm run pub
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version=false && npm run pub
